options.name: The Stack
options.thesis: Career identity looks like one solid thing and is actually five; the picture is a five-band stack that grows, gets numbered, gets named, gets interrogated and ends whole.
options.carrier: five-band vertical stack, fixed coordinates, present in all 31 beats
milestones: b13 three of five named, two still blank
b31 all five named and gold under a resolving rule
options.motion_logic: establish -> transform -> settle, once per beat; 0.45-0.55s opacity+rise entrances, 0.3s right-column exits, no repeating or ambient motion
options.primary_risk: quiet beats could read as twin frames while the four act transitions spike frame churn

options.name: The Audit Ledger
options.thesis: The audit is a 5x3 table: five layers down the side, three questions across the top, filled cell by cell.
options.carrier: 5x3 matrix drawn empty and completed by the close
milestones: completed grid with the honour column gold
options.motion_logic: rules draw in with scaleX from the left; cells fill with a mark scaling from 0
options.primary_risk: 15 cells plus labels force body type under the 40px floor, and a completed matrix asserts a per-layer x per-question structure the approved script never states
